name: Stiff Leg Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on a low platform with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar with nearly straight legs.
Lift the bar by extending your hips.
Lower the bar below the platform level under control.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A stiff-leg deadlift from a raised platform that increases the stretch on the hamstrings.
